name: Dual Instant
description: Run one instant fast and one slow across the two hands at once.

name: Moment Pair
description: Strike a pair of blows whose times are a heartbeat apart so the guard breaks on the first.

name: Matched Lull
description: Listen to the matched lulls between a foe's breaths and learn when both hands are idle.

name: Pair Slow
description: Slow an opponent's two arms at different rates so they cannot coordinate a guard.

name: Twin Hasten
description: Hasten the time of two allies in step so that both move one pace ahead.

name: Moment Salve
description: Mend a wound in two moments at once so the flesh closes from both edges.

name: Stopped Pair
description: Stop two opponents in the same moment where they stand.

name: Dual Reach
description: Thrust through the span of two heartbeats at once so the point lands before the guard is raised.

name: Mirror Moment
description: Step out of one moment and into its twin a pace away so the user stands where the blow was not.

name: Echo Pair
description: Hit a point and repeat the hit twice in quick echoes.

name: Mirror Echo
description: Echo the shape of a blow with the forearm and turn the blow with the echo.

name: Pulse Echo
description: Send a quiet pulse of time outward and read what it returns.

name: Echoed Step
description: Step and send an echo of the step to a place the user does not go.

name: Return Blow
description: Repeat the motion of a block as a strike a moment later so the foe's guard meets a second blow.

name: Echo Hold
description: Echo a binding grip on both arms so the hold lasts twice as long.

name: Echo Wash
description: Echo a cleansing touch so a lingering taint is drawn out on the second sweep.

name: Echo Chain
description: Chain a strike with two echoes of itself in one long moment so a single blow lands three times.

name: Paired Shield
description: Hold a guard and its echo one behind the other so a blow that breaks the first still meets the second.

name: Resounding Moment
description: Echo one great blow outward across the ground in rings with each ring a moment later than the last.

name: Wide Interval
description: Widen the gap between each of the user's own movements until none is rushed.

name: Gap Cut
description: Cut through the widened gap in an opponent's guard before it can close.

name: Thin Instant
description: Hold a thin shell of stilled instant before the chest to catch one blow.

name: Interval Bind
description: Fix an opponent in the interval between two heartbeats where nothing moves on.

name: Interval Salve
description: Spread the mending of a wound across a long interval so the body does not tear as it heals.

name: Skip Pace
description: Skip a pace of time so the user stands one step ahead of where the blow lands.

name: Interval Lance
description: Thrust a lance whose time starts late so it passes the guard as the guard lowers.

name: Sealed Interval
description: Seal the flow of qi in the interval between two of an opponent's breaths and keep it sealed.

name: Perfect Interval
description: Slip entirely into the interval between two moments and pass through a barrier unharmed.

name: Sworn Tempo
description: Swear the tempo of the wind and keep the body to it.

name: Beat Cut
description: Cut on the beat that a gust gives.

name: Tempo Ward
description: Turn aside a blow on the downbeat of a gust.

name: Gust Reading
description: Read the age of a gust to know where a person last stood.

name: Sworn Quicken
description: Quicken an ally's pace to the user's own on a sworn word.

name: Tempo Bind
description: Hold an opponent's tempo to a sworn slower beat.

name: Gust Mend
description: Mend an ally's wound on the breath of a gust so it closes as the wind falls.

name: Gale Instant
description: Strike in the instant between two gusts where no guard stands.

name: Sworn Slow
description: Slow all who stand against the oath within sight of the user.

name: Rushing Moment
description: Let the wind carry the user out of one moment and into the next a long open stride away.

name: Bearing Delay
description: Hold a delay along the line between the user and the mark.

name: Stayed Beat
description: Strike on the beat of the held line.

name: Course Sense
description: Read how long a target has held the same course.

name: Mud Delay
description: Stretch a delay along a bearing so anything that crosses it moves slowly as through deep mud.

name: Steady Quicken
description: Hold an ally's quickened time steady along a bearing.

name: Cadence Mend
description: Quicken the mending of an ally along a set course of treatment.

name: Delayed Lance
description: Cast a lance along the bearing whose arrival is delayed until the mark lowers its guard.

name: Bearing Stall
description: Stall everything on the bearing in a held moment.

name: Fixed Moment
description: Fix one moment on the bearing so nothing that passes through it can strike.

name: Unbroken Span
description: Keep a single unbroken span of attention that no blow can interrupt.

name: Span Cut
description: Cut across a whole span of the opponent's guard in a single motion.

name: Open Span
description: Sense the open stretch of time before a move and read what it will be.

name: Span Ward
description: Hold a ward across a span of several breaths without wavering.

name: Long Stride
description: Stretch each stride through the span to cover a great distance.

name: Bound Span
description: Bind an opponent's limbs inside one long span so they cannot leave it.

name: Mending Span
description: Carry the mending of an ally's wound whole through one long span.

name: Clean Span
description: Carry a cleansing touch through one long span until a stubborn taint is gone.

name: Reaching Span
description: Cast a lance that crosses the whole span in an instant and lands before it is seen.

name: Hushed Span
description: Seal the qi of a foe inside a span that nothing can break until the oath ends.

name: Unbroken Instant
description: Take a blow into the span of a long moment and let it lose its force there before it reaches the body.
